query:
SELECT
            ob.plan_tier::text AS "plan_tier!",
            ob.base_researched_allowance AS "base_researched_allowance!",
            ob.account_pack_allowance AS "account_pack_allowance!",
            ob.researched_allowance AS "researched_allowance!",
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
                FROM organization_researched_accounts ora
                WHERE ora.organization_id = $1
                  AND ora.removed_at IS NULL
            ) AS "active_researched_count!",
            ob.priority_account_limit AS "priority_account_limit!",
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
                FROM organization_researched_accounts ora
                WHERE ora.organization_id = $1
                  AND ora.removed_at IS NULL
                  AND ora.enrollment_priority_order IS NOT NULL
            ) AS "active_priority_count!"
         FROM organization_billing ob
         WHERE ob.organization_id = $1
         LIMIT 1
